s.note: the Gotham football game where the field collapses
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.

s.note: Selina Kyle stealing the pearls from Wayne Manor
s.how: Toss 250g bocconcini pearls with olive oil, torn basil and a pinch of chilli flakes and leave for an hour. Thread onto toothpicks with cherry tomatoes. Arrange on a dark plate like a string of stolen pearls and drizzle over the leftover oil.

m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs and 30g parmesan and roll 16 meatballs. Brown, then simmer in 700g passata for 20 minutes. Fill 4 long rolls, top with provolone slices and grill until melted.

w.note: Alfred at the café in Florence
w.how: Brew a strong pot of espresso. Put a big scoop of vanilla ice cream into each glass and set out a few amaretti biscuits alongside. At the table, pour a hot shot of espresso over each scoop and eat straight away while it melts.

d.note: Alfred's dream of seeing Bruce happy in Florence
d.how: Brew short, strong espresso and pour into small warmed cups. Peel thin strips of lemon zest and set one on each saucer to twist over the coffee if wanted. Serve it quietly, the way a butler who has seen it all would.
